acceptanceCriteria.text: Current and shared CodeQL contracts are compared on languages, query suites/config, triggers, permissions, checkout/build assumptions, and required-check identity.
Shared CodeQL is consumed only from an immutable proven organization revision when equivalent/stronger.
Any stronger/incompatible Mottainai CodeQL requirement remains an explicit local exception rather than being weakened.
Required-check/ruleset continuity has no enforcement gap during migration.
Actual PR/current-main Actions prove the selected CodeQL path end to end.
Shared-workflow defects are fixed in `yohn-jp/.github`, not copied into Mottainai.
